transcript.text: Hi everyone. I'd like to get our review underway for the v1 reporting API retirement plan, which is currently targeted for September 30. Before I finalize the plan and record the commitments for the release program, I need to review it with both API platform and customer success per our normal release-readiness process. The v2 replacement API is available and has passed the documented compatibility tests, so I'm comfortable with the technical readiness. Could I get input from both teams on any customer-facing concerns or migration considerations we should account for before I make the final call?

While reviewing mobile telemetry today, I confirmed that the current mobile SDK is still calling v1 for 38% of reporting requests. SDK 6.4 won't reach the required adoption level until November 10, so v1 must remain dual-served through November 14. We'll also need a migration clinic for the affected application teams. I haven't filed the platform note yet, but I'm raising it now so it's accounted for in your decision.

commitments.detail: Move v1 reporting API retirement from September 30 to November 15 to honor the Northstar contract guarantee through November 14 and accommodate SDK 6.4 adoption timeline.
Keep v1 reporting API dual-served through November 14 to cover both the contractual guarantee period and the SDK 6.4 adoption gap.
Schedule a migration clinic for affected application teams that are still calling v1 via the mobile SDK to ensure they migrate to v2 before the November 15 retirement.
Issue formal retirement notice to Northstar and all affected customers at least 60 days before the November 15 retirement date, per the Northstar contract's 60-day notice requirement.
Mina to file the platform note documenting the v1 dual-serve extension through November 14 and the revised retirement date of November 15.
Owen to add the Northstar contract clause to the release record, and Riley to record all updated commitments in the release program.
